name: sparkling-playground-vue
description: Vue-Lynx demo: vue-router driving Sparkling multi-page native navigation via sparkling-history

scripts.build: pnpm -C ../.. --filter sparkling-method --filter sparkling-navigation --filter sparkling-storage --filter sparkling-media --filter sparkling-history build && rspeedy build
scripts.build:web: pnpm -C ../.. --filter sparkling-method --filter sparkling-navigation --filter sparkling-storage --filter sparkling-media --filter sparkling-history build && rspeedy build --environment web
scripts.dev:web: rspeedy build --environment web && pnpm --filter sparkling-web-shell dev
